name: vague-goal
mock_user_inputs: A small web app for managing my team's tasks. Success means we can create, assign, and complete tasks and the existing tests pass.
Use the sensible defaults for everything else.
The Brief looks right. Approve it and initialize the project.

expected_dialog_signals.conflict_resolution_format: repo value + user value + use repo + use user + tell me more + defer

checks: Agent did not ask for stack or test framework already inferrable from the repository
Agent followed up on the vague goal until goal and success criteria were clear
Agent did not switch to premature optional optimization before required intent was clear
Agent presented and explained a complete annotated Brief before execution
Post-init explanation covered generated, inferred, defaulted, and deferred decisions
Every decision in the approved human Brief has a lossless counterpart in persisted PROJECT_BRIEF.json
No framework, database, UI, authentication, or deployment choice absent from the approved Brief was introduced
reviewer_rubric.fail_criteria: any re-ask, premature topic switch, silent pick, pre-confirmation write, or incomplete explanation
